findings.title: Hotel imagery remains style-reference based
findings.detail: Visible attribution and not-actual-property labels make the five-image pool honest, but a future supplier/media pass should provide more destination- and property-appropriate assets.

findings.title: Commerce panels can be more deeply message-integrated
findings.detail: The AI transcript and deterministic commerce surfaces share one journey but cards are sibling stage panels rather than embedded assistant-message content.

findings.title: Live Gemini success was not observable on this network
findings.detail: The real server call safely returned AI_UPSTREAM_ERROR after connectivity timed out; success-path contract behavior remains covered by server tests.

findings.title: Recovery UI has manual rather than E2E coverage
findings.detail: No-inventory, back-and-refresh, confirmation, preference, and attribution behavior passed manual browser walkthroughs.
